description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the PsrHttpFactoryHelper in the OAuth Service plugin of the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods that convert between custom request/response objects and PSR-7 HTTP message implementations, as well as creating requests/responses from PSR-7 objects.

classes.name: PsrHttpFactoryHelperTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case for testing the PsrHttpFactoryHelper methods converting between framework and PSR-7 HTTP message objects.

methods.name: testCreatePsr7Request
methods.description: Tests creation of PSR-7 request objects from framework Request objects, including GET and POST with headers.

methods.name: testCreatePsr7Response
methods.description: Tests creation of PSR-7 response objects from framework Response and BinaryFileResponse objects, including content and headers.

methods.name: testCreateRequestFromPsr7Request
methods.description: Tests creation of framework Request objects from PSR-7 server request objects.

methods.name: testCreateResponseFromPsr7Response
methods.description: Tests creation of framework Response objects from PSR-7 response objects.
